title: The Antom Payments WordPress plugin through 2.0.11 does not perform any ownership or authorisation check before…
description: The Antom Payments WordPress plugin up to version 2.0.11 has a vulnerability where it does not verify ownership or authorization before disclosing an order's confirmation link containing a secret key. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive customer order details such as name, address, phone number, and email.
